C gov002.read-spec OL GOV-002,GOV-008 MUST ;; For a new application or substantial feature read SPECIFICATION.md (and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md) before planning or implementing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.inspect-first OL WF-001 MUST ;; Inspect relevant existing code before any non-trivial change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.read-rules-explicitly OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read every rule whose paths match areas to be created or changed (explicitly for new files/greenfield, since path rules load only with matching files) and load knowledge skills for the technologies involved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.classify-before-implement OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify open decisions with Decision Control; Reserved goes to architecture-decision before implementing that part. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.raise-concern OL GOV-018 MUST ;; If the request looks questionable raise the concern and an alternative before implementing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.route-subtasks OL WF-001,DEP-003,GOV-021,ARC-027 MUST ;; Route sub-tasks: dependency changes to add-dependency, CUSTOM_SETTINGS changes to custom-settings, new projects/structural changes to project-structure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov007.sync-durable OL GOV-007 MUST ;; When a new behavioural rule is approved update the durable source of truth (SPECIFICATION.md when appropriate; CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md via custom-settings for tunable values). ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.seeder-cochange OL PST-008,PST-006 MUST ;; Whenever a Domain/persistence change affects seeded entities (required/removed/renamed properties, relationships, enum/status values, states, invariants) update DbSeeder in the same change so recreating Development yields valid representative data; existing databases are not patched by the seeder. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst010.migration-review OL PST-010,PST-008 MUST ;; Treat EF Core migrations as source code: review every generated migration before committing (destructive changes, column recreation, data migrations, indexes, FKs, delete behaviour); review DbSeeder with migrations affecting seeded entities. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.regression OL TST-009 DEFAULT ;; For a meaningful bug with plausible recurrence add a regression test that fails before and passes after the fix, unless equivalent coverage exists. ;; = ;; Equivalent coverage exists. ;;
C run012.procedure OL RUN-012 MUST ;; Performance-motivated changes: identify the bottleneck, preserve behaviour, simplest optimization, add/preserve tests, benchmark/profile non-obvious or complex optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf016.fix-at-source OL WF-016 DEFAULT ;; When generated output is wrong or its source changes fix the authoritative source, regenerate and review; do not manually patch disposable output unless intentionally maintained; for Angular-consumed contracts verify backend contract, regenerate client, review, then fix handwritten code. ;; = ;; Output intentionally treated as maintained source. ;;
C api022.deprecation OL API-022 MUST ;; When deprecating an externally consumed version mark it in versioning metadata, document the replacement, communicate a realistic timeline and keep it working for the promised support period; do not remove without considering the support contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf017.ci-truthful OL WF-017 MUST ;; CI definitions stay in source control, reproduce supported build/test commands and never hide failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.frontend-ci OL WF-018 MUST ;; Frontend CI uses existing package.json scripts and npm ci with a maintained lockfile; do not invent scripts or reflexively replace lockfile installs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.prod-migrations OL WF-019,PST-004 MUST_NOT ;; Do not apply production migrations automatically from normal startup by default; production migration is an explicit, controlled, visibly failing deployment operation with approved credentials; never run Development seeding in Production. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf002.review-before-verify OL WF-002 MUST ;; For substantial features or new applications run code-review (or code-reviewer agent) and address findings before final verification. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.verify-before-complete OL WF-003 MUST ;; Before declaring implementation complete run verify at a depth appropriate to scope and risk. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.failures-to-build-fix OL WF-013 MUST ;; Build/test failures needing diagnosis go through build-fix, then back to verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-output EX WF-009,GOV-017 MUST ;; Report what changed, notable Delegated choices, unresolved Decision Requests, the verify report, and any change-specific obligation that was not applicable and why. ;; = ;; none ;; Workflow output-shape obligation (incl. reporting Delegated choices and non-applicable obligations) beyond the oracle.

C dep019.no-build-tooling-runtime OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Keep build tooling out of production runtime images. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-image-practices EX DEP-019,ARC-002 DEFAULT ;; Keep images reproducible and configuration external, keep Docker concerns separate from application architecture (no Docker-specific changes in Domain/Application), and use the platform's health-probe capabilities when practical. ;; = ;; When practical. ;; Container practices outside the oracle (EXC-006).
C x.dk-multistage EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use a multi-stage build for ASP.NET Core Dockerfiles. ;; = ;; none ;; Dockerfile shape is conditional technique outside the oracle (EXC-006).
C x.dk-copy-practices EX - DEFAULT ;; Copy only repository-level build files that exist and are needed for restore; copy project files explicitly; avoid wildcard tricks that flatten multi-project structure. ;; = ;; none ;; Dockerfile copy technique not in the oracle.
C x.dk-restore-caching EX - DEFAULT ;; Copy project/build dependency files before the full source for restore caching; update the copy section when structure changes; never trade correctness of the restored project graph for caching. ;; = ;; none ;; Restore-layer caching technique not in the oracle.
C dep019.runtime-image-kind OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use the ASP.NET runtime image for ASP.NET Core apps and an appropriate .NET runtime image for non-ASP.NET workers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-nonroot EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use the built-in non-root user of modern .NET images when it fits. ;; = ;; When it fits. ;; DEP-019 forbids switching to root to bypass problems; actively running as the built-in non-root user is additional.
C dep019.fix-permissions OL DEP-019 MUST ;; Ensure writable directories have correct ownership/permissions and find the cause of permission problems instead of switching users. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-runtime-config EX SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Pass environment-specific configuration at runtime (e.g. ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, ConnectionStrings__Default). ;; = ;; none ;; Runtime-configuration practice for containers beyond the oracle.
C sec001.docker-no-credentials OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Real credentials never go into Dockerfiles, committed Compose files, build arguments visible in image metadata or copied appsettings with production secrets. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.docker-secret-mechanisms OL SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Use platform/container secret mechanisms where appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.compose-only-used OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Add only infrastructure the project actually uses to Compose (not PostgreSQL/Redis/RabbitMQ because examples have them). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.local-passwords OL SEC-002 MUST ;; Keep local Compose passwords in an ignored .env or another local developer mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-probes EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Expose liveness/readiness via ASP.NET Core health checks and prefer orchestrator HTTP probes; do not assume curl/wget/shell in runtime images; verify or add a probe mechanism weighing the cost of debug packages. ;; = ;; none ;; Probe mechanics are container technique outside the oracle (EXC-006).
C x.dk-angular-container EX - DEFAULT ;; For static Angular deployment build in a Node stage and serve assets with the selected hosting strategy (Nginx not mandatory); keep API base URLs/environment config compatible with the deployment. ;; = ;; none ;; Frontend container technique outside the oracle.
C x.dk-dockerignore EX - DEFAULT ;; Exclude non-build files from the Docker context (.git, bin, obj, node_modules, etc.); do not exclude tests the image build runs; never exclude files required by restore/build. ;; = ;; none ;; Build-context hygiene not in the oracle.
C x.dk-image-optimization EX DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Start with standard supported .NET runtime images; use Alpine/chiseled/trimming/Native AOT only when justified and verify globalization, native dependencies, reflection and diagnostics. ;; = ;; Compatibility and deployment requirements justify. ;; Image-size optimization discipline is outside the oracle (EXC-006).
C x.dk-verify EX WF-006 MUST ;; For Docker changes build the image, verify startup, ports/configuration, non-root behaviour, health-probe integration, review for accidental secrets/files, and run meaningful tests in or outside the pipeline. ;; = ;; As relevant. ;; Docker-specific verification checklist beyond WF-006.
